scope: Twenty-replicate pipeline, parser, failure-accounting, and nondegenerate decision-mapping pilot; not confirmatory operating characteristics.

input_identity.byte_identity_note: The Windows refit serialization differs in line endings/number formatting from the historical macOS bundle. FACETS and the Python Table 8 step adapter therefore consumed the original immutable bundle bytes; comparison-result hashes are recorded separately.

python_refit.console_exit_incident: All atomic artifacts and bridge checks were complete before a final CP932 console print raised UnicodeEncodeError. The CLI now replaces unencodable console characters without changing the retained UTF-8 report.

facets_450.postrun_summary_change: Replaced a smoke-specific degenerate-no-flag sentence with counts computed from the already-retained eligibility and agreement CSVs; no FACETS or Python numerical table was altered.

table8.claim_limit: No equivalence tolerance was preregistered; descriptive numerical alignment only.

table13.claim_limit: Nondegenerate decision mapping and parser qualification; not confirmatory false-positive rate or power.

metacognitive_finding: The corrected absolute-origin anchor semantics reduced focal strong flags in the 0.6-logit anchored conditions from 18 to 3 (anchor drift) and from 11 to 3 (clean anchors), while FACETS matched the corrected eligible decisions. This demonstrates why external comparison must precede estimator-performance interpretation.
next_gate: Freeze a confirmatory design that separates full-depth FACETS/JMLE lanes from stratified MML sensitivity lanes, excludes this pilot from confirmatory performance estimates, and retains unavailable/nonconverged outcomes as such.
